corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉・観察・測定を分けて残す
corrections.beforeEn: Record personal words, observations and measurements separately
corrections.afterEn: Record the person’s own words, observations and measurements separately

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉・観察・測定を分けて残す
corrections.beforeEn: Record personal words, observations and measurements separately
corrections.afterEn: Record the person’s own words, observations and measurements separately

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉、行動と測定値を情報源ごとに区別する。
corrections.beforeEn: Separate personal words, actions and measurements by information source.
corrections.afterEn: Separate the person’s own words, actions and measurements by information source.

corrections.sourceJa: 未測定でも本人の言葉と観察した行動には価値があり、区別して残します。
corrections.beforeEn: Personal words and observed actions remain valuable without measurements and should be retained separately.
corrections.afterEn: The person’s own words and observed actions remain valuable without measurements and should be retained separately.

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉、感じ方、希望などは主観的な情報です。職員が見た様子や、実際に測った数値などは客観的な情報です。血圧・体温の実測値や、医療職から共有された検査データもその例です。検査データは情報源を記し、介護職員が独自に病名を判断する材料にはしません。主観的だから価値がない、数値だから本人の言葉を無視してよい、とは考えず、情報源を分けて記します。
corrections.beforeEn: The person’s words, feelings and wishes are subjective information. What workers observe and values actually measured are objective information. Examples include measured blood pressure and temperature and test data shared by healthcare professionals. Identify the source of test data; care workers do not use it to diagnose independently. Subjective information is not worthless, and numbers do not justify ignoring personal words. Record sources separately.
corrections.afterEn: The person’s words, feelings and wishes are subjective information. What workers observe and values actually measured are objective information. Examples include measured blood pressure and temperature and test data shared by healthcare professionals. Identify the source of test data; care workers do not use it to diagnose independently. Subjective information is not worthless, and numbers do not justify ignoring the person’s own words. Record sources separately.

corrections.sourceJa: 【学習用の事例】「枕を置きました」という記録だけでは、どこを支えたか、本人が楽になったかはわかりません。支持した部位と位置、痛みや呼吸の様子、本人の言葉、調整後に確認した結果を残します。枕の存在を、安楽を確認したことへ置き換えません。
corrections.beforeEn: [Learning example] ‘Placed a pillow’ does not establish what was supported or whether comfort improved. Record the supported area and position, pain and breathing, personal words and confirmed results after adjustment. A pillow’s presence is not confirmed comfort.
corrections.afterEn: [Learning example] ‘Placed a pillow’ does not establish what was supported or whether comfort improved. Record the supported area and position, pain and breathing, the person’s own words and confirmed results after adjustment. A pillow’s presence is not confirmed comfort.

corrections.sourceJa: 記録に「枕を置いた」とあるだけで、安楽な姿勢になったと言えるか考えます。支持した部位、圧迫、本人の言葉と実際に確認した結果を分けます。
corrections.beforeEn: Consider whether a placed-pillow record proves comfort. Separate supported area, pressure, personal words and actual checked results.
corrections.afterEn: Consider whether a placed-pillow record proves comfort. Separate supported area, pressure, the person’s own words and actual checked results.

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の見え方、聞こえ方、言葉の使いやすさに合わせて質問し、答える時間を確保します。見ていないのに赤みなし、測っていないのに平常と記録しません。本人の言葉、観察したこと、測定値は分けて残します。
corrections.beforeEn: Adapt questions to vision, hearing and language and allow response time. Do not record no redness without looking or normal values without measuring. Separate personal words, observations and measurements.
corrections.afterEn: Adapt questions to vision, hearing and language and allow response time. Do not record no redness without looking or normal values without measuring. Separate the person’s own words, observations and measurements.

corrections.sourceJa: これらは引き継ぎを読むための学習用の記録です。本人の言葉、聞いた時刻、報告した時刻を対応させ、本文にない原因やその後の状態を補わずに伝えましょう。
corrections.beforeEn: These are learning records for reading handovers. Match personal words, the time heard and the time reported. Do not add unstated causes or subsequent condition.
corrections.afterEn: These are learning records for reading handovers. Match the person’s own words, the time heard and the time reported. Do not add unstated causes or subsequent condition.

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉と皮膚の観察は、どちらも必要な情報です。
corrections.beforeEn: Personal words and skin observations both matter.
corrections.afterEn: The person’s own words and skin observations both matter.

corrections.sourceJa: 腹痛などの訴えがある場合は、場所、始まった時点、本人の言葉を記録し、医療職や指導担当者へ伝えます。図の向きだけで原因を判断したり、腹部へ力を加える処置を始めたりしません。
corrections.beforeEn: For abdominal pain or similar complaints, record location, onset and personal words and tell healthcare professionals or the training supervisor. Diagram direction alone does not determine cause or authorize a procedure applying force to the abdomen.
corrections.afterEn: For abdominal pain or similar complaints, record location, onset and the person’s own words and tell healthcare professionals or the training supervisor. Diagram direction alone does not determine cause or authorize a procedure applying force to the abdomen.

corrections.sourceJa: 相談するときは、本人の羞恥心とプライバシーに配慮します。人前で不要に身体を見せたり、関係のない人に情報を広げたりせず、必要な相手に、確認できた部位・本人の言葉・未確認の内容を分けて伝えます。
corrections.beforeEn: Respect embarrassment and privacy when consulting. Avoid unnecessary exposure in public or spreading information to uninvolved people. Tell necessary recipients separately the confirmed area, personal words and unconfirmed content.
corrections.afterEn: Respect embarrassment and privacy when consulting. Avoid unnecessary exposure in public or spreading information to uninvolved people. Tell necessary recipients separately the confirmed area, the person’s own words and unconfirmed content.

corrections.sourceJa: 期待した結果にならなかったら、情報が足りなかったか、説明や参加の条件が合っていたか、目標そのものが本人に適しているかをチームで振り返ります。結果を本人の努力不足と決めつけず、本人の言葉と観察した事実を手掛かりに考えます。
corrections.beforeEn: If expected outcomes are not reached, review as a team whether information was missing, explanation or participation conditions fit, and the goal itself suited the person. Do not attribute the result to inadequate personal effort; use personal words and observed facts.
corrections.afterEn: If expected outcomes are not reached, review as a team whether information was missing, explanation or participation conditions fit, and the goal itself suited the person. Do not attribute the result to inadequate personal effort; use the person’s own words and observed facts.

corrections.sourceJa: 本人の言葉を聞き、身体の部位を確かめる場面です。この絵は大腸の位置や腹部マッサージを示すものではありません。
corrections.beforeEn: Listen to personal words and check body locations. This picture does not show colon orientation or abdominal massage.
corrections.afterEn: Listen to the person’s own words and check body locations. This picture does not show colon orientation or abdominal massage.

corrections.sourceJa: 満足の程度は外から判断できないため、本人の話も記録しない。
corrections.beforeEn: Do not record personal words because satisfaction cannot be judged externally.
corrections.afterEn: Do not record the person’s own words because satisfaction cannot be judged externally.

corrections.sourceJa: 職員の推測で決めないことは、本人の言葉を無視することではありません。大切な評価情報として記録します。
corrections.beforeEn: Avoiding staff assumptions does not mean ignoring personal words. Record them as important evaluation information.
corrections.afterEn: Avoiding staff assumptions does not mean ignoring the person’s own words. Record them as important evaluation information.

corrections.sourceJa: 嚥下は飲み込む働き、誤嚥は食物や液体などが声帯より下の気道へ入ることです。飲み込みにくさ全般と誤嚥を同じ意味にしません。「むせる」「咳込む」は反応や本人の言葉を表しますが、その語だけで原因や誤嚥の有無を診断したり、とろみを独自に変更したりしません。
corrections.beforeEn: 嚥下 means swallowing; 誤嚥 means food, liquids or other material entering the airway below the vocal cords. General swallowing difficulty and aspiration are not identical. むせる and 咳込む describe reactions or personal words, but these terms alone do not diagnose causes or aspiration or authorize independently changing thickening.
corrections.afterEn: 嚥下 means swallowing; 誤嚥 means food, liquids or other material entering the airway below the vocal cords. General swallowing difficulty and aspiration are not identical. むせる and 咳込む describe reactions or the person’s own words, but these terms alone do not diagnose causes or aspiration or authorize independently changing thickening.

corrections.sourceJa: それぞれの時刻・部位・機器、活動直後だったこと、本人の言葉、脈拍と呼吸が未確認であることを分けて記録し、変化を担当者に報告します。
corrections.beforeEn: Record each time, site and device, the recent activity, personal words and unchecked pulse and breathing separately, and report the change to the responsible person.
corrections.afterEn: Record each time, site and device, the recent activity, the person’s own words and unchecked pulse and breathing separately, and report the change to the responsible person.

corrections.sourceJa: 測定条件、本人の言葉、未確認の項目を区別することで、受け手が状況を理解できます。数値だけで病名や原因を決めず、気になる変化を共有する対応です。
corrections.beforeEn: Separating conditions, personal words and unchecked items helps the recipient understand. Share concerns without determining a disease or cause from numbers alone.
corrections.afterEn: Separating conditions, the person’s own words and unchecked items helps the recipient understand. Share concerns without determining a disease or cause from numbers alone.

corrections.sourceJa: 介護職員： 見たこと、ご本人の言葉、確認した対応を分けます。原因とそれ以前の状態は不明と記録し、回復したとは書きません。
corrections.beforeEn: Care worker: I’ll separate observations, personal words and confirmed responses. I’ll record cause and earlier condition as unknown, not recovery.
corrections.afterEn: Care worker: I’ll separate observations, the person’s own words and confirmed responses. I’ll record cause and earlier condition as unknown, not recovery.
